# EmailFlow UK — Email Marketing & Automation Agency

> EmailFlow is a UK-based e-commerce email marketing agency specializing in Klaviyo, Omnisend, and automated retention flows. We help online stores generate 20–30%+ of total store revenue from email channels within 7 to 60 days.

## Core Agency Services
- **Pricing**: £800/month all-inclusive management (no hidden fees or extra invoices).
- **Automated Retention Flows**: Custom building of 7 core e-commerce email flows (Welcome Series, Abandoned Cart, Abandoned Checkout, Browse Abandonment, Site Abandonment, Post-Purchase, and Win-Back).
- **Email Deliverability Engineering**: Full SPF, DKIM, DMARC setup, inbox placement, sender reputation management, and Gmail/Yahoo compliance.
- **Weekly Campaign Management**: Copywriting, custom responsive email design, list segmentation, and A/B testing (3–4 campaigns/week).
- **Platform Expertise**: Klaviyo, Omnisend, Shopify Email, and MailerLite.

## Key Performance Benchmarks & Results
- **Average Client Revenue Lift**: +20–30% increase in total e-commerce revenue from email.
- **Setup Speed**: Audit & strategy in 24 hours; complete automated system live in 7 days.
- **Cart Recovery Rate**: 5–15% abandoned cart recovery rate.
- **Open Rates & CTR**: Welcome Series 50–60% open rates; cart recovery 40–50% open rates.

## Primary Target Audience & Geography
- **Primary Market**: United Kingdom (London, Manchester, Birmingham, UK nationwide) & English-speaking global e-commerce stores.
- **Ideal Business Profile**: E-commerce stores with monthly revenue of £10,000 to £500,000+.
